purpose: Teach: 至極/入団/簡易裁判所/身動き/座標/品番/邦題/体勢

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、社員に至極丁寧に教えられた
lines.en: When I was starting out, your grandfather taught our staff with such meticulous care.
lines.style: Warm, measured recollection. Gentle weight on 「至極丁寧に」 — pride without flourish. Slow, deliberate pacing like reviewing a cherished memory. Soft landing at the close.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは新人入団時に直接歓迎された
lines.en: Yes. He personally welcomed each new hire himself.
lines.style: Respectful affirmation with quiet strength. Clear, direct delivery — a son confirming his father's legacy. Even pacing. No embellishment, just facts that carry their own weight.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、簡易裁判所での訴訟も自ら対応されたぞ
lines.en: And he handled our legal disputes himself, even the ones in small claims court.
lines.style: Admiring tone beneath the surface. Slight shake of the head — almost in disbelief at the dedication. Slower pace on 「自ら対応」. Trailing warmth at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは資金繰りで身動きが取れない時期も乗り越えられた
lines.en: He did. Even during years when cash flow tied his hands completely, he found a way through.
lines.style: Steady, thoughtful response. Quiet emphasis on 「身動きが取れない」 — understanding the weight of that struggle. Composed but not detached. Slight pause before the affirmation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、新店舗の座標を地図で確認された
lines.en: He would check the coordinates of every new location on the map himself.
lines.style: Gentle admiration with a trace of wonder. Slower, almost meditative pacing. Light touch on the specific detail — painting a picture of painstaking care. Soft fadeout.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは商品の品番制度を整えられた
lines.en: He did. And he created the entire product numbering system for the company.
lines.style: Measured acknowledgment with quiet pride. Steady rhythm — each accomplishment given equal respect. Voice level and grounded. No need to elevate; the work speaks.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、海外作品の邦題決めにも関わられた
lines.en: He was even involved in deciding the Japanese titles for overseas works.
lines.style: Voice lifts slightly with appreciation for the breadth of his father's reach. Wondering tone — this detail catches him a little. Unhurried delivery. Soft landing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは経営の体勢を時代に合わせて変えられた
lines.en: Yes. He transformed how the company operated to match each era — never letting it grow stale.
lines.style: Closing affirmation with gravitas. Slightly slower, more deliberate than before — the culmination of a son's understanding. Warm finality without sentimentality. Breath of closure.
